llm.summary: This documentation-writing skill is purpose-aligned and clean, with only a minor risk that broad trigger words could invoke it more often than intended.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe generating and remediating documentation, checking writing quality, loading an optional style profile, and preserving meaning during edits.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms such as writing, generation, and polish, but the runtime instructions ask the agent to define scope, identify target files, use quality gates, and receive user approval.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown skill and module files; metadata declares related configuration dependencies but there are no executable installers, hooks, or hidden setup steps in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Read/Edit use, optional reading of .scribe/style-profile.yaml, and local slop or quality checks are proportionate to documentation generation and remediation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No artifact-backed evidence shows credential handling, background workers, persistence, privilege escalation, destructive operations, or data exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, expect this skill to influence documentation writing and remediation workflows and to edit target docs when asked. Consider narrowing trigger phrases if you want it to activate only for explicit documentation tasks.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is valid as usability guidance, but the terms are related to the documented writing workflow and do not create a material security concern by themselves.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the markdown-only artifacts inspected.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean across supplied engines and does not conflict with the artifact review.
